stories.title: KPMG Canada says client documents accessed in cybersecurity breach
stories.summary: KPMG Canada says some client tax documents were accessed in a cybersecurity breach. The accounting firm did not provide details about the breach, including the scope or nature of the attack. KPMG is reaching out to clients who were affected.

stories.title: Sarah Nurse feeling healthy, excited as Vancouver Goldeneyes prep for second season
stories.summary: VANCOUVER — Watching the women's world hockey championships on a screen this month felt odd for Sarah Nurse. The star forward is used to being in Canada's biggest games, not watching her teammates play from thousands of kilometres away.
